task_definition.task_description: Can you check the stock level for the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones (p_sony_xm5_blk) and see if I have any available coupons for my account (user_123)? Then, please get collaborative recommendations for alternatives in the electronics category, select the best recommendation for one unit, and build my cart items from that selection. After that, get a cart summary applying the coupon code 'SAVE15', build an invoice from the summary, and generate the final invoice to be paid via Stripe for customer@example.com. Finally, fetch the latest business news and sort the headlines in ascending order.

user_input.query: Hi! Can you check the stock for the black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones (p_sony_xm5_blk) and see if there are any coupons available for my account, user_123? I’d also like to get some collaborative recommendations for other electronics. Please pick the best alternative for a quantity of 1, add it to my cart, and provide a summary using the coupon SAVE15. From there, build an invoice and generate the final version to be paid via stripe for customer@example.com. Finally, could you fetch the latest business news and sort the headlines in ascending order for me?
